meta.title: SRIJAN 2K26 | Inter-College Hackathon, SRMCEM Lucknow
meta.description: Two days, your idea. Screening online on 13 Oct, finale at SRMCEM Lucknow on 14 Oct. Teams of one to four.

event.name: SRIJAN
event.venueFull: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial College of Engineering & Management, Lucknow
event.eligibility: Students from SRMCEM and other colleges

about.heading: Ideas in. Prototypes out.
body: SRIJAN 2K26 is an inter-college hackathon that brings together students, developers, innovators and technology enthusiasts to build practical solutions to real-world problems.
It pushes students beyond theoretical learning, turning ideas into working prototypes through teamwork, technology and problem-solving.

explainer.heading: New to hackathons?
explainer.text: A hackathon is an event where small teams turn an idea into a working prototype and present it to judges.

cards.d: One event in two formats: an online round first, then an in-person finale.
Students from SRMCEM and other colleges can take part.
Bring a team of 2 to 4 members.
The finale is hosted on campus in Lucknow, the City of Nawabs.

tracks.heading: Six domains. Pick your battlefield.

problemStatements.heading: Problem Statement Tracks
problemStatements.note: Choose your track and build your solution around these core hackathon themes.

items.title: AI & Machine Learning
items.text: Build intelligent systems, predictive models, autonomous AI agents, computer vision applications, or NLP solutions that learn from data to solve complex real-world challenges and automate decision-making.

items.title: Web & App Development
items.text: Create responsive, high-performance web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, or seamless digital platforms focusing on exceptional UI/UX, robust backend architecture, and modern web frameworks.

items.title: Cybersecurity
items.text: Develop security solutions, threat detection mechanisms, zero-trust architectures, ethical hacking tools, or data encryption systems to defend digital infrastructure against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

items.title: Smart Campus Solutions
items.text: Innovate connected IoT devices, automated attendance/navigation systems, smart energy management, or digital campus utilities to enhance safety, sustainability, and daily student life.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: Design eco-friendly solutions, renewable energy trackers, carbon footprint analyzers, smart waste management, or social impact tools aimed at combating environmental degradation and climate change.

items.title: Open Innovation
items.text: Have a novel or groundbreaking idea outside the standard domains? Build an original, out-of-the-box solution using any tech stack to tackle real-world problems and drive technological impact.

cards: Building systems that learn from data to predict, classify, generate or automate decisions that normally need human judgement.
Designing and building websites and mobile or desktop apps that people use through browsers and devices.
Protecting systems, networks and data from unauthorised access, attacks and misuse.
Technology ideas, such as connected devices, automation and data tools, that make a campus safer, more efficient and easier to use.
Solutions that reduce environmental harm or address community needs such as health, education and accessibility.
A free-choice theme for original ideas that do not fit the other five but solve a real problem.
tracks.intro: Each domain is a theme for your idea. The note under each is general background, not an event rule.
lines: Teach software to learn, predict and help people decide.
Turn an idea into something people can open and use.
Protect people, data and systems from misuse.
Use connected technology to make campus life simpler and safer.
Use technology to help communities and the planet.
Have a different idea? Bring it.

days.blurb: The first round is held online.
The second day is in person at SRMCEM Campus, Lucknow, with demos, judging and rewards.

prizes.heading: Cash Prizes & Rewards
prizes.sub: Compete for top positions & exciting rewards at SRIJAN 2K26!
prizes.suspenseNote: 🔒 Cash Prize amounts are kept under suspense & will be revealed live on the Grand Finale stage!

pptNotice.title: 📢 MANDATORY FOR FINALE TEAMS
pptNotice.text: All teams selected for the final offline round MUST keep their presentation slides (PPT) ready before arriving for the finale round at SRMCEM Campus!

items.a: Students from SRMCEM and other participating colleges and universities.
An event where teams turn an idea into a working prototype and present it. SRIJAN 2K26 is for building practical solutions to real-world problems.
The event runs in two formats. Day 1 (13 Oct) is the online screening and Day 2 (14 Oct) is the offline finale at SRMCEM Campus, Lucknow.
